## Instructions for Accurately Documenting Reportable Workplace Accidents

These instructions are designed to ensure compliance with safety regulations and provide a clear record of incidents for investigation, prevention, and potential legal purposes.  "Reportable" accidents are those meeting criteria defined by OSHA (in the US) or equivalent regulatory bodies in other countries – typically involving fatalities, serious injuries/illnesses (requiring hospitalization beyond first aid), amputations, loss of an eye, or certain types of chemical exposures.
